oracle.name: Power Pages Liquid renderer
oracle.scope: Two independent native Power Pages page loads of the same published Liquid sources on 2026-11-11; establishes rendered text for these sources on this site only.

templates.newline-to-br-capture:
{% capture t %}one
two{% endcapture %}{{ t | newline_to_br }}

templates.concat-two-arrays: {% assign a = 'x,y' | split: ',' %}{% assign b = '1,2' | split: ',' %}{{ a | concat: b | join: '' }}

templates.blank-equality: {% assign e = '' %}{% if e == blank %}blank{% else %}not blank{% endif %}

templates.empty-array-equality: {% assign arr = '' | split: ',' %}{% if arr == empty %}empty{% else %}full{% endif %}

templates.elsif-chain: {% assign n = 2 %}{% if n == 1 %}one{% elsif n == 2 %}two{% elsif n == 3 %}three{% else %}other{% endif %}

templates.case-when-multiple: {% assign v = 2 %}{% case v %}{% when 1, 2 %}low{% when 3 %}mid{% else %}high{% endcase %}

templates.contains-string: {% if 'hello world' contains 'lo w' %}yes{% else %}no{% endif %}

templates.contains-array-miss: {% assign parts = 'a,b,c' | split: ',' %}{% if parts contains 'z' %}yes{% else %}no{% endif %}

templates.and-or-precedence: {% if true or false and false %}A{% else %}B{% endif %}

templates.for-limit: {% for i in (1..10) limit: 3 %}{{ i }}{% endfor %}

templates.for-offset: {% for i in (1..5) offset: 2 %}{{ i }}{% endfor %}

templates.for-reversed: {% for i in (1..4) reversed %}{{ i }}{% endfor %}

templates.forloop-index-flags: {% for i in (1..3) %}{{ forloop.index }}{% if forloop.first %}F{% endif %}{% if forloop.last %}L{% endif %}{% endfor %}

templates.break-in-loop: {% for i in (1..9) %}{% if i == 3 %}{% break %}{% endif %}{{ i }}{% endfor %}

templates.continue-in-loop: {% for i in (1..5) %}{% if i == 2 %}{% continue %}{% endif %}{{ i }}{% endfor %}

templates.for-else-empty: {% assign none = '' | split: ',' %}{% for x in none %}{{ x }}{% else %}none{% endfor %}

templates.for-else-nonempty: {% assign items = 'a,b' | split: ',' %}{% for x in items %}{{ x }}{% else %}none{% endfor %}

templates.capture-reassign-variable: {% assign v = 'one' %}{% capture v %}two{% endcapture %}{{ v }}

templates.increment-counter: {% increment n %}{% increment n %}{% increment n %}

templates.raw-block-literal: {% raw %}{{ 'not rendered' | upcase }} {% if x %}{% endraw %}

templates.trim-both-if: x  {%- if true -%}  y  {%- endif -%}  z
